review_notes.message: Infographic-to-animation package is ₹25,000 for all 30 videos (≈ ₹833 per video), while a single 1-minute animated video package (VID-001) is ₹3,00,000. Confirm the ₹25,000 is intended for the full set before reusing it.
Line is headed 'Hotel booking' in the proposal but its description and price (₹3,000 per advisor) cover food only. Room cost is not priced anywhere.
Streaming line says '6 separate webinars' but is priced at quantity 1 (₹75,000). Confirm whether the quote is per event.
Supersedes CIPLA-ISP-2026-06 (same client and programme; honorarium changed from €2,000 to US$5,000). Both versions are kept as history.
No internal cost data was found in any of the 11 documents. All proposals show client-facing selling prices only, so margins cannot be calculated until internal costs are entered.
Payment terms differ: 50% / 50% (ISP and Sep 2026 proposals) versus 60% / 40% (most Oct–Nov 2026 proposals).
